answer: Make each new identity borrow standing from one established sponsor, who may back at most one newcomer per week. Each epoch a randomness beacon picks a few newcomers for a deep audit. If one is caught as a clone, the slash will ripple up: the sponsor loses its bond and vouching rights, and its vote weight falls to the nadir of everyone it ever backed. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 sponsors, each risking real history, so cost grows with every head.
